**Howie Good — Provenance Anchor** is a Crimson Hexagonal Archive record for a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort.

The position’s lead manifestation is *Martyr* in *New Human Compiled, Ed. 1*. The anchor was minted retrospectively in 2026 from that printed textual ground.

The record does not assert that the position is identical or non-identical with any external person sharing the name. It is a journal-position provenance object, not a biography.
